authorization: existing user full-research instruction; scientific and resource gates remain distinct

selection.formal_default: all source events; split subjects before forming any windows
selection.optional_development_subset: first, middle and last 128-event windows of each ABC/D sequence, offsets 0/floor((N-128)/2)/N-128; freeze source-row manifest before fitting or scoring labels
selection.subset_claim: development pilot only; never replace the all-event confirmation result
selection.timestamp_order: integer tick then original source line; no gap clipping, resampling or window search
selection.clock: data.py exact declared display model; elapsed seconds = integer tick difference / 10000000

model_identity: S4D is the declared SSM route; no result is labeled Mamba

capacity.reference: effective trainable real scalar degrees of freedom of the admitted HCSN configuration
capacity.selection: choose architecture widths before label scoring by exact parameter counts; no dead/frozen/unused parameter padding
capacity.plain_gate_control: match bank slot count, content width, effective parameters and shared inputs; report state bytes separately

tuning.optimizer: AdamW; honor official S4 parameter-specific learning-rate/zero-decay groups and record them
tuning.selection_metric: mean development macro-F1 across three independent tuning seeds; deterministic tie break by fewer parameters then lower compute
tuning.test_access: none during tuning, debugging, calibration design or early stopping

training.state_policy: fresh episode per nonoverlapping training window; optimizer updates only between episodes; preserve original first gap at each artificial boundary
training.loss: cross entropy with common ABC-only inverse-square-root class-frequency weights, normalized to mean one
training.shuffle: deterministic train-window permutation shared across models for each seed; never shuffle within an episode
training.adequacy: finite gradients, training-only multiclassepisode memorization check, development plateau; record PLIF firing/tau and all learning curves; budget exhaustion is not convergence

confirmation.evaluation_context: fixed nonoverlapping 256-event episodes for every model; no undeclared recurrent history advantage
confirmation.statistics: paired training-seed differences; sequence-clustered data uncertainty; episodes never count as independent fits; one held-out subject limits population inference

resource_admission.formal_budget_status: not allocated; the executed 30-minute interface envelope is not reused as a formal-study allowance
resource_admission.requirement: freeze an independent numeric all-attempts per-arm and whole-study wall/RAM envelope after timing calibration; reject unknown costs rather than treating them as zero

remaining_implementation_gates: capacity-configurable official adapters and formal episode trainer
full-context numerical profile for frozen physics
pruned readout and ordinary-gate control implementations
claim_boundary: This specifies a reproducible training protocol; run_interface.py intentionally does not execute it. Missing gates remain explicit, with no claim of formal-study completion.
